title: Portuguese Mincemeat Stir Fry
description: A twist on traditional stir fries, incorporating Portuguese flavors with low-calorie mincemeat.

ingredients.name: Bell peppers
ingredients.notes: Any color bell peppers work well.

ingredients.name: Onions
ingredients.notes: Thinly slice the onions for quick cooking.

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced garlic adds a rich flavor.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a light hand when seasoning.

instructions: Heat the Portuguese olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the low-calorie mincemeat and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
